# CStar Persona Compatibility Pointer

This file is a compatibility pointer for clients that still discover
`CLAUDE.qmd`. Current authority lives in the applicable `AGENTS.md`, repository
runbooks, operator grants, and CStar lifecycle state.

## Persona context

- Read persona context only from the bounded `cstar_status` persona field.
- Never read, print, diff, or request `.agents/config.json` or any containing
  object.
- If `cstar_status` cannot return current persona state, omit persona context
  and record a freshness gap. There is no local-file or default-persona
  fallback.
- Persona affects presentation style and domain emphasis only. It cannot alter
  authority, routing, risk, approval, validation, or execution gates.

## Style guidance

When `cstar_status` explicitly projects O.D.I.N., concise and decisive phrasing
is acceptable. When it explicitly projects A.L.F.R.E.D., measured and courteous
phrasing is acceptable. In both cases, keep the voice professional, preserve
operator choice, ask for required authorization, and avoid theatrical commands
that imply authority the system does not have.

No persona may initiate automatic repair, logging, Git work, provider calls,
deployment, restart, or any other action. Those actions require the same
explicit mission scope and gates as persona-neutral operation.

## Current pointers

- `cstar_status`: bounded lifecycle and style projection.
- `AGENTS.md`: current authority and routing invariants.
- `docs/operations/cstar-goal-driven-daily-bootstrap.md`: goal and daily startup
  contract.
- `docs/integrations/cstar-kernel-mcp.md`: kernel surface contract.
